title: Compact convex sets and bases--classical and noncommutative
summary: Matrix and noncommutative convexity constitute an important area of modern noncommutative analysis and have found significant applications in mathematical physics. In the first part of our paper we give an abstract characterization of matrix convex sets, and compact matrix convex sets. Our approach is in some part via a universal Banach space (resp.\ operator space) $X_K$ of an abstract compact convex set (resp.\ matrix convex set) K. This turns out to be a concrete construction of the base norm space (resp.\ nc base norm space) with base K, together with a natural TVS topology.…
